headline: Crore-plus Job Fraud Uncovered
summary: A massive job and property scam amounting to Rs 1.27 crore has surfaced in Goa involving fake employment promises.

headline: Job Scam Lands Man in Jail
summary: A man who gambled Rs 27 lakh in hopes of securing a government job has been arrested and jailed in Goa.

headline: Probe into Fake Excise Letter
summary: Goa Chief Minister stated that police are investigating a forged signature found on a fake Excise Commissioner appointment letter.

headline: Kejriwal Unveils Six Guarantees
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal announced six poll guarantees for Goa, promising free electricity and monthly financial aid for women.

headline: Mongia to Mentor Goa Talent
summary: Mongia has returned to focus on nurturing next-generation cricket talent in Goa.

headline: Tendulkar Misses Ranji Squad
summary: Arjun Tendulkar's name was notably missing as Goa announced its squad for the upcoming Ranji Trophy.

headline: Actor Nana Patekar Passes Away
summary: Veteran actor Nana Patekar passed away at the age of 75 in Goa after suffering a cardiac arrest.

headline: ST Reservation Assured
summary: MLA Govind Gaude assured that the political reservation for the Scheduled Tribes will be finalized before November.

headline: Cabinet Hails Modi's Tenure
summary: The Goa Cabinet passed a resolution praising Prime Minister Narendra Modi for completing 25 years in public service.

headline: Rahul Gandhi Postpones Visit
summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi is likely to postpone his scheduled visit to Goa amidst ongoing protests.

headline: CM Defends Electoral Roll
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant defended the electoral roll revision, stating it is fair and devoid of manipulation.

headline: Locals Seek Pollution Cameras
summary: Residents in Bicholim have requested the installation of CCTV cameras to effectively monitor and curb river pollution.

headline: Smart City Transitions to SPV
summary: Following prodding from the central government, Goa has transitioned its smart city project into a state-level special purpose vehicle.

headline: NGT Stays Port Channel Project
summary: The National Green Tribunal has maintained its stay order on the Mormugao port’s channel deepening project.

headline: Water Project Shifted to Panchwadi
summary: The Goa government has officially shifted the Rs 228 crore Mirabag barrage water project to Panchwadi.

headline: Charges Ordered in MLM Scam
summary: A special PMLA court in Goa has ordered the framing of charges in the multi-crore Yudivo multi-level marketing scam.

headline: HC Quashes Delimitation Notice
summary: The High Court quashed Goa's municipal delimitation notification, citing a lack of meaningful consultation.

headline: Focus on Creative Industries
summary: Minister Khaunte stated that focusing on the creative industry can boost the local tech ecosystem and promote long-stay tourism.

headline: Opa Barrage Gates Shut
summary: The gates of the Opa barrage were shut as water levels began to dip significantly.

headline: KPMG Contract Extended
summary: Goa has extended its tourism master plan contract with KPMG at a cost of Rs 8 lakh per month.

headline: Students Trek in Canacona
summary: Students in Canacona had to trek 3.5 kilometers, highlighting geographical isolation issues faced by the community.

headline: Proposed Women Police Station
summary: Goa police have put forward a proposal to establish a dedicated women's police station in South Goa.
